pages.title: Wrangler
pages.text:
Wrangler
Bruiser
Scrapper
Glider
Mycologist

Wrangler
Employee #84239756
Technical Information
API Name
Wrangler

"Since the Wild West craze ended, Wrangler has had a tough time landing an audition. Saxon immediately scooped him up upon realizing he could do a triple blackflip like it was nothing. Still hopeful for his next big break, he does his best to spin his stunt skills towards actual combat, complete with a lasso and a healthy amount of southern charm. COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 2/5"

Wrangler performing his signature dance

Wrangler is a washed up actor, left without work after people lost interest in the Wild West. He can use his lasso to pull himself and enemies, and is capable of dashing midair.

Abilities[edit | edit source]
Rocket Lasso - Throw a rocket-powered lasso that can pull objects or launch you forward.
Air Dash - Jump while airborne to dash forward.
pages.edited: This page was last edited on 22 October 2026, at 20:56.

pages.title: Bruiser
pages.text:
Wrangler
Bruiser
Scrapper
Glider
Mycologist

Bruiser
Employee #1353876
Technical Information
API Name
Bruiser
Bruiser performing their signature dance

"Retired as an automated security robot and given sentience, Bruiser was awoken with the worst hangover imaginable. Upon taking their first look around, Bruiser knocked nearly every tooth out of their superior's mouth with a single punch, and was escorted out of the building. What followed was a series of gambling, drinking, fights, and other bad decisions that eventually landed them here. COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 1/5"

Bruiser is a former automated security bot, and after being given sentience and a lot of gambling, drinking, and fighting has ended up working for Saxon. They are capable of creating a shield that blocks incoming bullets and ground pounding while in the air to damage nearby enemies.

Abilities[edit | edit source]
Hard-Light Projector - Project a shield that stuns enemies and reflects incoming projectiles.
Nose Dive - Jump while airborne to slam into the ground, emitting a shockwave that damages and launches nearby targets.
pages.edited: This page was last edited on 22 October 2026, at 20:58.

pages.title: Scrapper
pages.text:
Wrangler
Bruiser
Scrapper
Glider
Mycologist

Scrapper
Employee #5947206
Technical Information
API Name
Scrapper
Scrapper performing her signature dance

"Accidentally left to rust on a Saxon dumping planet, Scrapper built herself up from the scraps others left behind. Over countless years she honed her skills and improved herself. One fateful day she hijacked a dumping ship and threatened to crash it into something important if her demands weren't met. Not wanting to waste such an interesting asset, Saxon offered her a job instead. COMPANY CULTURE RATING: N/A"

Scrapper was accidentally left on a Saxon dumping planet, and built herself up until she could hijack a ship, but instead of having to crash it, Saxon offered her a job. Scrapper can construct a grappling pole for herself and allies to use as well as use her salvaged jetpack for vertical mobility.

Abilities[edit | edit source]
Grapple Pole - Construct a tall pole that any ally can grapple to.
Jetpack - Hold jump to gain height.
pages.edited: This page was last edited on 22 October 2026, at 20:57.

pages.title: Glider
pages.text:
Wrangler
Bruiser
Scrapper
Glider
Mycologist

Glider
Employee #913268181
Technical Information
API Name
Glider
Glider performing her signature dance

"Formerly a member of the Galactic Safety Commission, Glider was built and trained as a search and rescue drone. Being a drone, she was programmed with limited mental faculties and her memories were strictly proprietary. Saxon offered to remove these restrictions if she defect and join their expedition. Unbeknownst to her, this allows Saxon to automatically pass GSC inspections. COMPANY CULTURE RATING: 3/5"

Glider is a former GSC rescue drone, recruited by Saxon in exchange for removing her restrictions, and used by them as a sort of insider in the GSC, capable of allowing Saxon to pass GSC inspections automatically. Glider is capable of firing a barrage of rockets that hurt enemies and heal teammates, as well as using her wingsuit to swiftly fly over terrain and enemies.

Abilities[edit | edit source]
Rocket Salvo - Lock on and fire a barrage of rockets and damage enemies and heal allies.
Wingsuit - Hold jump to activate your wingsuit jets and fly forward.

quests
rewards

The backlog is a system of objectives that the player can use to gain bonus rewards while on their missions. Players can move to the next page upon finishing by paying 10% of their current resources. The backlog is also the only location by which the player can gain access to a set of skins for the characters. This is an excellent progression system for newer players to gain bonus experience and upgrades.

	Paid Time Off
	Abomination Assault

These 6 missions rotate every ~10 minutes and can be found in the 4 different zones on New Atlas.

Mission Modifiers

There is a total of 29 types of modifiers that can appear on missions.

As of now there is one additional modifier (30) for the Amalgamation Hunt Event.

Each modifier varies in how much flat additional increase in experience ranging from +0% - +100%.
